name: Zeiss apochromatic objectives
summary: Zeiss launched apochromatic microscope objectives made with new Jena glasses, designed to bring colours to a common focus far better and so give clearer images.
description: A manufactured series of microscope objectives using new glass materials and optical formulae, designed to improve chromatic and spherical correction and paired with compensating eyepieces.
tier_reason: A major reusable result, process or system within its field; broader multi-field or multi-generation dependence on this exact referent is not established.

market.note: Zeiss offered this configuration for sale at stated prices in its 1889 catalogue. This supports commercial applicability but does not establish the first offer or a completed sale.
